description: This file defines a guardrail class 'ToolPermissionGuardrail' for managing permissions on tool calls within a language model API, including pre- and post-call hooks, permission checks, and response modifications.

classes.name: ToolPermissionGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class that enforces permission rules on tools used in language model interactions, supporting pre- and post-call hooks, permission validation, and response modification.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the guardrail with rules, default actions, and supported event hooks.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail.

methods.name: _matches_regex
methods.description: Checks if a value fully matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: _rule_matches_tool
methods.description: Determines if a rule matches a given tool name and type.

methods.name: _check_tool_permission
methods.description: Checks if a tool is permitted based on rules, returning allowance status, rule ID, and message.

methods.name: _parse_tool_call_arguments
methods.description: Parses arguments from a tool call, decoding JSON if necessary.

methods.name: _collect_argument_paths
methods.description: Recursively collects argument paths and values from nested data structures.

methods.name: _patterns_match_for_rule
methods.description: Checks if arguments match allowed patterns for a rule.

methods.name: _get_permission_for_tool_call
methods.description: Determines permission for a specific tool call, considering rules and argument patterns.

methods.name: _extract_tool_calls_from_response
methods.description: Extracts tool call objects from a model response.

methods.name: _modify_request_with_permission_errors
methods.description: Modifies request data to replace denied tool calls with error results.

methods.name: _create_permission_error_result
methods.description: Creates a result object indicating a permission error for a tool call.

methods.name: _modify_response_with_permission_errors
methods.description: Modifies a model response to replace denied tool calls with error messages.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook to check tool permissions before model invocation.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook to verify tool usage permissions after model response.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook
methods.description: Stream hook to check permissions during streaming responses.
